OL-G00_PROBABILITY_DISTRIBUTION_ALIGNMEN.demonstrated: Owner-selected finite occupation-density scope and explicit probability interpretation.
OL-G00_PROBABILITY_DISTRIBUTION_ALIGNMEN.not_demonstrated: Posterior representativeness or universal application coverage.
OL-G00_PROBABILITY_DISTRIBUTION_ALIGNMEN.advances_goal: Defines a bounded initial forecast population without replacing the eventual Bayesian objective.

OL-G01_REPRESENTATION_CONTRACT.demonstrated: Explicit law-to-density-to-FE-to-voxel-to-tensor contract within tested scope.
OL-G01_REPRESENTATION_CONTRACT.not_demonstrated: Continuum accuracy or suitability of all future laws.
OL-G01_REPRESENTATION_CONTRACT.advances_goal: Prevents representation changes from silently changing the forecast problem.

OL-G02_RECONSTRUCTION_STABILITY.demonstrated: Scoped reconstruction sensitivity under frozen finite controls.
OL-G02_RECONSTRUCTION_STABILITY.not_demonstrated: Exact occupation measure, invariant density or posterior accuracy.
OL-G02_RECONSTRUCTION_STABILITY.advances_goal: Separates reconstruction uncertainty from genuine input-law variation.

OL-G03_INPUT_DIVERSITY.demonstrated: Recorded finite occupation laws are separated beyond declared reconstruction controls.
OL-G03_INPUT_DIVERSITY.not_demonstrated: Sufficient coverage for accurate learning, distinct invariant laws or arbitrary initial-condition generalization.
OL-G03_INPUT_DIVERSITY.advances_goal: Rules out complete collapse to effectively identical training inputs; useful coverage remains open.

OL-G04_REFERENCE_TARGET_APPLICABILITY.demonstrated: Reference discretization sensitivity meets prospective criteria for a specified accepted population.
OL-G04_REFERENCE_TARGET_APPLICABILITY.not_demonstrated: Universal continuum accuracy or surrogate qualification.
OL-G04_REFERENCE_TARGET_APPLICABILITY.advances_goal: Ensures the proposed supervised targets can support the forecast accuracy question.

OL-G05_EXPORT_FIDELITY.demonstrated: Export and learning-grid errors meet a frozen error budget.
OL-G05_EXPORT_FIDELITY.not_demonstrated: Neural accuracy or accuracy outside the tested representations.
OL-G05_EXPORT_FIDELITY.advances_goal: Prevents learning-representation bias from dominating full-density forecast error.

OL-G06_DATA_PROVENANCE.demonstrated: Complete authenticated data lineage and scientifically valid grouped splits.
OL-G06_DATA_PROVENANCE.not_demonstrated: Numerical truth from hashes alone or unrestricted population coverage.
OL-G06_DATA_PROVENANCE.advances_goal: Makes forecast evidence reproducible and reduces leakage.

OL-G07_OPERATOR_STRUCTURE.demonstrated: Measured departure from fixed-physics linearity of the implemented numerical map.
OL-G07_OPERATOR_STRUCTURE.not_demonstrated: Exact linearity of the corrected numerical scheme.
OL-G07_OPERATOR_STRUCTURE.advances_goal: Identifies structured baselines and intervention-induced target effects.

OL-G08_BASELINE_QUALIFICATION.demonstrated: Controlled comparison with persistence, nearest target, learned/POD linear, convolutional and FNO candidates.
OL-G08_BASELINE_QUALIFICATION.not_demonstrated: FNO preference or application readiness by model name.
OL-G08_BASELINE_QUALIFICATION.advances_goal: Tests whether nonlinear learning adds value over strong forecast alternatives.

OL-G09_FIT_FEASIBILITY.demonstrated: Adequate fit to controlled training subsets under frozen criteria.
OL-G09_FIT_FEASIBILITY.not_demonstrated: Generalization or that longer training cures statistical defects.
OL-G09_FIT_FEASIBILITY.advances_goal: Separates optimization failure from population and model limitations.

OL-G10_GENERALIZATION.demonstrated: Within-population error distributions on untouched independent laws meet prospective baseline-relative criteria.
OL-G10_GENERALIZATION.not_demonstrated: All attractors, unseen families or posterior transfer.
OL-G10_GENERALIZATION.advances_goal: Tests predictive value beyond development examples.

OL-G11_STRUCTURAL_GENERALIZATION.advances_goal: Tests whether useful forecast structure transfers beyond known generators.

OL-G12_PROBABILITY_STRUCTURE.demonstrated: Density, mass, positivity, moments, marginals, lobes, tails and boundaries meet frozen criteria.
OL-G12_PROBABILITY_STRUCTURE.not_demonstrated: Accuracy from normalization or positivity alone.
OL-G12_PROBABILITY_STRUCTURE.advances_goal: Protects probabilistic fidelity required by later Bayesian updating.

OL-G13_SEMIGROUP.demonstrated: Tested two-step forecast consistency against independent 2T references.
OL-G13_SEMIGROUP.advances_goal: Checks composability before recurrent forecast use.

OL-G14_ROLLOUT.demonstrated: Forecast-only recurrent stability over a specified finite horizon/population.
OL-G14_ROLLOUT.advances_goal: Detects accumulating forecast errors before introducing observations.

OL-G15_ACCURACY_COST.demonstrated: Measured accuracy/cost Pareto comparison with full FPE and structured surrogate alternatives.
OL-G15_ACCURACY_COST.not_demonstrated: Replacement speedup from training time or a single timer.
OL-G15_ACCURACY_COST.advances_goal: Determines whether a scientifically accurate surrogate provides practical value.

OL-G16_POSTERIOR_TRANSFER.demonstrated: Forecast performance on independently generated full Bayesian posterior inputs.
OL-G16_POSTERIOR_TRANSFER.advances_goal: Bridges occupation-law studies to the eventual posterior forecast population.

OL-G17_SEQUENTIAL_INTERFACE.demonstrated: Repeated posterior-density forecast interfaces meet frozen numerical/statistical criteria.
OL-G17_SEQUENTIAL_INTERFACE.not_demonstrated: Automatic authorization of a complete operator-assisted assimilation system.
OL-G17_SEQUENTIAL_INTERFACE.advances_goal: Establishes prerequisites for a separately governed full-density Bayesian DA programme.
